caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object positioned diagonally across the image, with a long, slender shaft that extends from the left side of the composition to a more complex, looped structure on the right. The left end of the object has an oval-shaped hole or loop, while the right end consists of three adjacent, thick curves forming a bulbous, open structure. The object is colored in shades of brown with touches of reddish and orange tones, suggesting a rusty or aged surface. Below the main object, towards the bottom center of the image, there is a looping outline rendered in a pale brown color that mimics the curved shapes of the upper structure. The background is off-white and unadorned, with the artist's small signature, "Elizabeth Johnson," in black text in the lower left corner.
title: Branding Iron
